limitations: One frozen complete campaign: five workloads by two modes by twenty attempts equals 200 scheduled sessions. The first --max-pairs 5 execution is the immutable ten-session schedule prefix, not a separate smoke campaign.

The Git lane reproduces the observable Codex App managed-worktree boundary: the host creates a detached linked worktree before the first model event and closes it after the terminal event. Codex Desktop private IPC is not invoked, and Desktop UI latency is not measured.

The AIT lane is sprint-off solo_local and omits --edit-root, so the measured agent follows the worktree returned by task start; the Git lane starts directly in its host-prepared worktree. Both use fresh ephemeral Codex sessions, the same task fixture, permission policy, network policy, runtime pins, evaluator, and browser acceptance contract.

The requested omission of --edit-root intentionally charges AIT for consuming and following task start's returned next_action while Git begins inside its host-prepared worktree. Interpret this as a default product-flow comparison, not an isolated worktree-mechanism comparison.

model-request-state.json records executor-visible thread identity, turn terminal state, terminal usage, reroute, safety, and provider-error event counts. Internal provider request count is unavailable from Codex events and is never inferred from turn count.

A zero-lane predecessor with the unsuffixed campaign identity completed its 30-command executor preflight but stopped before the first measured model session because an over-restrictive runtime-pin file mode made the copied fixture transform target read-only. Its 559143 preflight tokens remain separately preserved; no measured lane, mode result, or token direction existed to select or retry.

A second zero-lane predecessor with the -r2 campaign identity completed its 30-command executor preflight but stopped while constructing the first managed Git lane before model launch because the permission profile inherited an inaccessible parent-main .git write exception. Its 551935 preflight tokens and scaffolded non-model run remain separately preserved; no measured lane, mode result, or token direction existed to select or retry.
No functional replacement policy is declared: every protocol-valid unaccepted outcome remains acceptance-penalized evidence, and no token or elapsed direction can select continuation.
